name: AutoComplete
description: Input feature that turns the field text into a popover-backed suggestion list with keyboard navigation and three replacement modes.

fields.popoverConstraints: BoxConstraints? - null caps the list at maxHeight
fields.popoverWidthConstraint: PopoverConstraint? - null keeps the field width as a minimum and hugs wider suggestions
fields.containerForeground: ThemedColor? - label colour inside the popover
fields.containerBorderWidth: double? - used when the border resolves
fields.containerPadding: EdgeInsetsGeometry? - shadcn p-1, so 4 all round
fields.itemTextStyle: TextStyle? - null = text-sm (14), colour from itemForeground
fields.gap: double? - vertical space between rows, 0 by default
fields.maxHeight: double? - list height cap, shadcn max-h-60 = 240

notes: Installable next to `input`: the field is the `input` component and this feature plugs into its generic suggestion slot (`InputFeature` + `SuggestionBuilder`, P3 design I2). It does not import `input`, so neither component depends on the other.
The old `AutoComplete` wrapper widget (which wrapped an opaque child and re-declared a field surface) is deleted; `AutoCompleteFeature` is the whole public surface.
`AutoCompleteMode` replaces both drifted old copies; `input` keeps only the generic `InputAutoCompleteFeature` slot.
`applyAutoCompleteSuggestion` is public so a host that owns its own field (or the `chip_input` component in B13) can reuse the same append/replace-word/replace-all surgery.
